critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1122 /plans/{pid}/pdf uses StreamingResponse with iter([data]) — buffers entire PDF in memory (up to 15MB per plan). Acceptable at current scale; consider chunked streaming for larger docs.
server.py:1101 create_plan stores PDF as base64 in Mongo doc — inflates document ~33% and doubles I/O vs GridFS. Fine for <=15MB cap but if plan libraries grow, migrate to GridFS.
server.py:1971 _period_range next_month arithmetic: total = y*12 + (m-1) + 1 - month_offset; then y2,m2 = total//12, total%12+1 — verified correct (Jul 2026 -> Aug 2026 label).

server.py:707 list_leads city/zip filters use $regex with ^ anchor — that means the filter is a PREFIX match (case-insensitive for city). Review request said 'starts with', so correct. Just documenting.

PlanBrochures.jsx uses window.open for PDF blob — works but pop-up blockers may intercept if the fetch is not user-triggered same-tick. Currently the click handler awaits fetch then calls window.open; on some browsers this loses the user-gesture context. Consider using an <a href=blob:...> that is clicked programmatically inside the same tick, or set target on an anchor.
useScrollRestore uses sessionStorage keyed by pathname+search — good. Note: if the route uses hash-only nav it wouldn't key correctly, but current app uses proper history routing so fine.
Leads.jsx ColFilter: Popover input has autoFocus — works, but on mobile Safari autoFocus in Popover sometimes fails to open the software keyboard. Non-blocker.
